_note: Suggested permissions for a get-me-hired workspace. `gmh setup permissions --workspace <ws>` (Claude Code only) merges the deny rules into <workspace>/.claude/settings.json and keeps what is already there; review before using. Deny rules hold in every permission mode. Submitting an application needs no rule here: the plugin's submit guard (hooks/approval_guard.js) asks before each one. Adapted from ai-job-search's settings (MIT).
